easyPrerequisites: You control any number of creatures that don't have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate a creature you control by tapping it, causing a player to mill cards equal to that creature's toughness.
If a creature card was milled this way, Zellix triggers, creating a 1/1 Horror creature token.
If a Horror entered, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
